name: drawing-callouts-simple
description: IXT-SUITES: drawing-set sheet callouts (pro). Hidden in Simple, present in Pro; the panel (#drawingCalloutsPanel) mounts, addDrawingCallout stores a callout (listed with sheet + position), undo removes it. Mobile leg; back-to-Simple hides it.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-hidden
steps.failMessage: drawingCallouts should be OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: drawingCallouts should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: add-callout
steps.eval: (()=>{ window.__store.getState().addDrawingCallout({text:'GL = 0.00 (verify on site)', sheet:'floor-plan', x:0.8, y:0.1, leaderX:0.5, leaderY:0.5}); })()

steps.name: assert-added
steps.failMessage: addDrawingCallout did not store the callout

steps.name: assert-undone
steps.failMessage: undo did not remove the callout

steps.name: assert-simple-again
steps.failMessage: drawingCallouts should be OFF after returning to Simple
